next_step: Execute 2-week POC for spike reliability with dedicated pool; share SOW + pricing by 2026-03-20
blockers: need EU data residency guarantee for EU customers
notes:
Account background:
- AegisWave builds contact-center SaaS for retail + telco customers; heavy seasonality (Black Friday, holiday promos).
- Mature platform: routing, workforce mgmt, analytics. Looking to add Redwood for agent-assist + ticket triage and to handle huge seasonal peaks.

Primary pain / spike reliability story:
- Current outages/backpressure during incident bursts and flash sales. Queues balloon -> degraded agent assist quality and timeouts against current LLM vendor.
- Need predictable unit economics under spikes. Business: 1–2 major retail customers with peaks up to 30k concurrent chat sessions.
- Must maintain p95 token response latency <250ms for agent-assist (short system prompts), ~<500ms acceptable for async ticket summarization.
- Target throughput for POC: sustain 2,500 inference reqs/sec for 1 hour with <3% error rate.
- Lossy fallbacks acceptable: degrade to quantized 4-bit model variant or cached responses per customer segment.

Security / compliance:
- SSO/SAML required; strict audit logging; KMS for customer keys.
- EU data residency required for EU accounts. Cannot export raw transcripts outside customer VPC for regulated customers — "we cannot expose raw transcripts outside our VPC" (quote from Head of Security).
- SOC2 is desired; they are currently completing SOC2 (expected June).

Technical preferences & constraints:
- Prefer dedicated pool (predictable throughput) for 2-week POC, then evaluate Dedicated vs Private based on scale and residency costs.
- Want autoscaling policy with burst buffer and model-variant fallback (high-quality -> low-latency quantized -> cached).
- Needs prefix/KV caching for repeated prompts (common in templated agent-assist flows).
- Tool-calling reliability is critical (ticket creation, CRM updates). Must guarantee once-only semantics or clear retry semantics for tool calls.
- Observability: per-token cost breakdown, route-level latency heatmaps, and error traces for fallback events.

POC scope & success criteria (agreed 2026-03-10):
- Setup: dedicated GPU pool in NA region, VPC peering, SSO test account.
- Tests: simulate 2,500 rps sustained for 1 hour; run 5 spike bursts (10x baseline for 5 min) to validate graceful degradation.
- Metrics: p95 latency <250ms for agent-assist, error rate <3%, automatic fallback triggers without total outage.
- Acceptance: post-POC report + cost/performance breakdown and runbook for production roll.
